Subject: AsterHealth integration: intermittent 5xx during reranker runs / KV cache hypothesis

Hi Samira & Liam —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and immediate asks so we can keep the spike moving:

- Observed behavior: some of your reranker batch requests against our hosted endpoint return 5xx (internal error) only when the request set contains a mix of short and long context prompts. Errors are intermittent (~3-5% of requests in a given minute).
- Hypothesis from the call: potential KV-cache key collision when session_id is reused across concurrent structured-tool calls + reranker embedding lookups. Priyom called out that this pattern can surface when embedding calls and structured tool calls share a short-lived request tag.

Next steps I promised:
1) Samira: share a redacted sample of the failing request payloads (headers + body) — preferably a 30-50 request sample we can replay.
2) Engineering: we will reproduce locally with the sample, capture a replay_trace, and try toggling per-request session tagging and KV cache isolation.
3) Ops: if reproduced, we propose a temporary mitigation: set session_isolation=true for your service role and add a lightweight retry wrapper for 5xx.

I've attached a small template you can paste into your test harness (sample_requests.json) and an architecture diagram with how we think requests flow.

Attachments: sample_requests.json (JSON request batch template), arch_diagram_v2.png (simplified flow)

If you can get the request samples over today we’ll attempt a replay tomorrow morning PST and share logs.

Thanks —

Jordan / team —

I pulled Samira's sample (thanks Samira) and ran a quick local replay under a dev harness. Repro steps and quick notes below:

Repro steps (local):
1) Use sample_requests.json as a single batch of 32 requests.
2) Run 8 parallel workers with concurrency=5 each (approx 40 concurrent).
3) Endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/serve/re-ranker (using token role "aster-prod-role").
4) Observed: ~4-6% of requests return 500 within 30s of run start.

What I captured:
- replay_trace_20261116.log (attached) — includes timelines, request_id mapping, and a short stderr showing an internal kernel OOM followed by a generic 500.
- Interesting correlation: 80% of 500s line up with requests that invoked a structured-tool call (tool_call metadata present) immediately before the embedding/reranker call. That sequence seems to cause the runtime to evict a shared KV entry and then the reranker hits a cache-miss path that triggers a slow path leading to an OOM under our current batching window.

Immediate theory: KV cache entries are not properly namespaced per-request_tag when a short-lived session_id is reused across rapid structured-tool calls. That can cause an unexpected cache churn and kernel memory pressure.

Suggested next steps (internal):
- Connor: can you try a patch that namespaces KV keys with request_id (long-form) rather than session_id and re-run the replay?
- Marissa: prepare a short rollback/mitigation note for the customer (set session_isolation=true and enable retry wrapper).

I'll be available for a call at 1pm PST if we want to run tests together.

Subject: Re: AsterHealth integration: intermittent 5xx during reranker runs / KV cache hypothesis

Samira / Jordan —

Quick update after the replay runs and a light patch: summary + actionable items below.

What we did:
- Implemented a short-lived patch that namespaces KV cache keys by request_id (uuid) instead of session_id and deployed to a canary pool for your token role.
- Replayed the same sample batch at 40 concurrent workers for 30 minutes.

Results:
- Error rate fell from ~4-6% to <0.2% during the test window.
- Memory pressure indicators stayed within nominal bounds; no kernel OOMs observed in canary agents.

Root cause (short):
- When structured-tool calls are made within the same session_id window, our KV cache used a truncated session tag that collided under high concurrency. That collision caused frequent eviction of necessary prefetched embeddings, which pushed the runtime into a slow path that occasionally triggered an OOM and surfaced as a 500 to the client.

Recommended production actions (what we propose next week):
1) Patch: make KV namespacing change permanent for your role (low-risk, isolated key format change). We have the patch ready and tested in canary.
2) Mitigation: temporarily enable session_isolation=true on AsterHealth token role and add a per-request retry (3 attempts, exponential backoff with jitter) for 5xx.
3) Long-term: we'll add a config knob to tune KV lifespan and introduce an observability metric for KV-churn to alert before 5xx thresholds.

Action items for Samira / AsterHealth:
- Approve the patch for your role (we'll schedule a 30-minute maintenance window).
- If you prefer, we can roll the mitigation first (session_isolation + retry) and follow with the patch the week after.

Attachments: arch_diagram_v2.png (annotated with canary flow), replay_trace_20261116.log (replay we ran)

Thanks — happy to hop on a call to walk through logs.
